title: WHIRLING F1 / SMOKER ON THE BALCONY
description: Smoker on the balcony, sitting in the bar.

dialogueTree.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Hi again, gendarme.""

links.title: You: ""What are you doing here?""
links.english: "What are you doing here?"
links.polish: „Co tu robisz?”
links.belarusian: "Што ты тут робіш?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Admiring the atmosphere..." He smi..."
links.english: "Admiring the atmosphere..." He smiles. "What about you, officer?"
links.polish: „Podziwiam atmosferę...” – uśmiecha się. „A ty, funkcjonariuszu?”
links.belarusian: "Любуюся атмасферай... — ён усміхаецца. — А ты, афіцэру?"

links.title: You: ""I live here, my room is right upst..."
links.english: "I live here, my room is right upstairs."
links.polish: „Mieszkam tu. Mój pokój jest na górze”.
links.belarusian: "Я тут жыву, мой пакой проста наверсе".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Convenient," he nods. "But what ar..."
links.english: "Convenient," he nods. "But what are you doing *here*, talking to me?"
links.polish: „Wygodne” – kiwa głową. „Ale co robisz *tutaj*, rozmawiając ze mną?”
links.belarusian: "Зручна, — ківае ён. — Але што ты робіш *тут*, размаўляючы са мной?"

links.title: You: ""I'm here to drink myself into obli..."
links.english: "I'm here to drink myself into oblivion."
links.polish: „Jestem tu, żeby się zapić na śmierć”.
links.belarusian: "Я тут, каб напіцца да непрытомнасці".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""A bit too dramatic, don't you thin..."
links.english: "A bit too dramatic, don't you think?" He says it like it's an aesthetic question. "If you really must do it then I'd go with something else... some other substance."
links.polish: „Nie sądzisz, że jesteś odrobinę zbyt dramatyczny?” – pyta, jakby to była kwestia estetyki. „Jeśli już musisz to zrobić, to na twoim miejscu wybrałbym coś innego... Jakąś inną substancję”.
links.belarusian: "Трохі занадта драматычна, табе не здаецца? — кажа ён так, нібыта гэта эстэтычнае пытанне. — Калі табе так ужо трэба, я б абраў нешта іншае... іншае рэчыва".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""But then again -- you're a cop, it..."
links.english: "But then again -- you're a cop, it definitely fits the genre." He looks at his hands folded on a table. "*I* fit the genre, we all do... moulded by fiction like we're characters in some bad novella."
links.polish: „Chociaż z drugiej strony, jesteś gliną – to pasowałoby gatunkowo” – spogląda na swoje dłonie złożone na stoliku. „*Ja* się w to wpisuję – wszyscy się wpisujemy... Jesteśmy kształtowani przez fikcję jak postacie w jakiejś kiepskiej powieści”.
links.belarusian: "Але з іншага боку — ты ж коп, гэта дакладна адпавядае жанру, — ён глядзіць на свае складзеныя на стале рукі. — *Я* адпавядаю жанру, усе мы адпавядаем... вылепленыя выдумкай, нібыта мы персанажы нейкага блазнога раманчыка".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Human psychology is definitely laz..."
links.english: "Human psychology is definitely lazy, don't you think?"
links.polish: „Ludzka psychologia jest zdecydowanie leniwa, nie sądzisz?”
links.belarusian: "Чалавечая псіхалогія вызначальна лянівая, не знаходзіш?"

links.title: You: ""This is where I'm going to go down..."
links.english: "This is where I'm going to go down in history: I'm going to sing karaoke."
links.polish: „Zamierzam zostać tu zapamiętany przez historię. Będę śpiewał karaoke”.
links.belarusian: "Вось дзе я ўвайду ў гісторыю: я заспяваю ў караоке".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Really?" He straightens up, curiou..."
links.english: "Really?" He straightens up, curious. "Well, I look forward to that!" He raises a glass to you.
links.polish: „Poważnie?” – pyta i prostuje się z zaciekawieniem. „Nie mogę się już doczekać!” – zapewnia, unosząc w twoim kierunku swoją szklankę.
links.belarusian: "Сапраўды? — ён выпрамляецца з цікаўнасцю. — Што ж, чакаю з нецярплівасцю!" — Ён падымае за цябе шклянку.

links.title: You: ""I'm here to kick some ass and solv..."
links.english: "I'm here to kick some ass and solve the case I'm working on."
links.polish: „Jestem tu, żeby skopać kilka tyłków i rozwiązać sprawę, nad którą pracuję”.
links.belarusian: "Я тут, каб надаць па азадках і раскрыць справу, над якой працую".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Well, here's to you!" He raises a..."
links.english: "Well, here's to you!" He raises a glass, before taking a sip of his drink, froth grazing his mouth.
links.polish: „Cóż, twoje zdrowie!” – unosi szklankę, po czym upija łyk drinka, którego pianka muska jego usta.
links.belarusian: "Што ж, за цябе!" — Ён падымае шклянку і робіць глыток, пена датыкаецца да яго вуснаў.

links.title: You: ""I don't know what I'm doing here...."
links.english: "I don't know what I'm doing here. I just go wherever life takes me."
links.polish: „Nie wiem, co tu robię. Zmierzam po prostu tam, dokąd prowadzi mnie życie”.
links.belarusian: "Не ведаю, што я тут раблю. Проста іду туды, куды нясе жыццё".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Hmm... maybe you should figure it..."
links.english: "Hmm... maybe you should figure it out, detective."
links.polish: „Hmm... Może powinieneś to rozgryźć, detektywie”.
links.belarusian: "Хм... можа, табе варта разабрацца з гэтым, дэтэктыве".

links.title: You: ""Tell me again about that *muscular..."
links.english: "Tell me again about that *muscular type* who came to investigate the crime."
links.polish: „Opowiedz mi jeszcze raz o tym *muskularnym facecie*, który przyszedł przyjrzeć się miejscu zbrodni”.
links.belarusian: "Раскажы мне яшчэ раз пра таго *мускулістага тыпа*, які прыходзіў расследаваць злачынства".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, yes... let's see. He knocked o..."
links.english: "Oh, yes... let's see. He knocked on my door a few days after the lynching. I think he was going through the entire building, asking questions."
links.polish: „A tak... Niech no pomyślę. Zapukał do moich drzwi kilka dni po linczu. Odwiedził chyba wszystkie mieszkania w budynku, zadawał pytania”.
links.belarusian: "О так... зараз узгадаю. Ён пастукаў у мае дзверы праз некалькі дзён пасля самасуду. Здаецца, ён абыходзіў увесь дом і распытваў".

links.title: You: ""What did you tell him?""
links.english: "What did you tell him?"
links.polish: „Co mu powiedziałeś?”
links.belarusian: "Што ты яму сказаў?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Nothing. That I didn't see anythin..."
links.english: "Nothing. That I didn't see anything."
links.polish: „Nic. Powiedziałem mu, że niczego nie widziałem”.
links.belarusian: "Нічога. Што нічога не бачыў".

links.title: You: ""And he believed you?""
links.english: "And he believed you?"
links.polish: „I ci uwierzył?”
links.belarusian: "І ён табе паверыў?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Why shouldn't he?""
links.english: "Why shouldn't he?"
links.polish: „A dlaczego miałby mi nie wierzyć?”
links.belarusian: "А чаму б не?"

links.title: You: ""Did you tell him about your friend?""
links.english: "Did you tell him about your friend?"
links.polish: „Nie powiedziałeś mu o swoim przyjacielu?”
links.belarusian: "Ты сказаў яму пра свайго сябра?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: "He takes another drag of his cigare..."
links.english: He takes another drag of his cigarette before knitting his brows. "What friend?"
links.polish: Zaciąga się jeszcze raz dymem z papierosa, po czym marszczy brwi. „Jakim przyjacielu?”
links.belarusian: Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку цыгарэтай і ссоўвае бровы: "Якога сябра?"

links.title: You: ""Your Sunday friend, the witness.""
links.english: "Your Sunday friend, the witness."
links.polish: „Twoim niedzielnym przyjacielu, świadku”.
links.belarusian: "Твайго нядзельнага сябра, сведку".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""No, I don't think it came up.""
links.english: "No, I don't think it came up."
links.polish: „Nie, raczej nie poruszaliśmy tego tematu”.
links.belarusian: "Не, не думаю, што да гэтага дайшло".

links.title: You: ""What did he look like?""
links.english: "What did he look like?"
links.polish: „Jak wyglądał?”
links.belarusian: "Як ён выглядаў?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Muscular. Handsome." He shrugs non..."
links.english: "Muscular. Handsome." He shrugs nonchalantly. "Strong. Like one of those military types."
links.polish: „Muskularny. Przystojny” – nonszalancko wzrusza ramionami. „Silny. Jak jeden z tych wojskowych typów”.
links.belarusian: "Мускулісты. Прыгожы, — ён нядбайна паціскае плячыма. — Моцны. Як адзін з тых вайсковых тыпаў".

links.title: You: ""Was he alone?""
links.english: "Was he alone?"
links.polish: „Był sam?”
links.belarusian: "Ён быў адзін?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Yes, but he was speaking to someon..."
links.english: "Yes, but he was speaking to someone on his earpiece."
links.polish: „Tak, ale rozmawiał z kimś przez słuchawkę w uchu”.
links.belarusian: "Так, але размаўляў з некім праз навушнік".

links.title: You: ""His earpiece?""
links.english: "His earpiece?"
links.polish: „Słuchawkę w uchu?”
links.belarusian: "Праз навушнік?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Yes, you know those tiny speaker-m..."
links.english: "Yes, you know those tiny speaker-microphones that fancy security guards sometimes wear."
links.polish: „Tak, no wiesz – takie malutkie głośniczki z mikrofonami noszone czasem przez eleganckich ochroniarzy”.
links.belarusian: "Так, ведаеш такія малюсенькія дынамікі з мікрафонамі, якія часам носяць фарсістыя ахоўнікі".

links.title: You: ""What was he saying?""
links.english: "What was he saying?"
links.polish: „Co mówił?”
links.belarusian: "Што ён казаў?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Just reporting back whatever I was..."
links.english: "Just reporting back whatever I was telling him."
links.polish: „Po prostu powtarzał to, co mu mówiłem”.
links.belarusian: "Проста пераказваў усё, што я яму казаў".

links.title: You: ""Besides *muscular*, did he have an..."
links.english: "Besides *muscular*, did he have any other identifying traits?"
links.polish: „Miał jakieś cechy szczególne poza tym, że był *muskularny*?”
links.belarusian: "Акрамя таго, што *мускулісты*, ці былі ў яго іншыя прыкметы?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, let me think..." He turns his..."
links.english: "Oh, let me think..." He turns his eyes upward in recollection. "He had an accent. He sounded like one of those mercenaries."
links.polish: „Och, niech no pomyślę...” – odpowiada, spoglądając gdzieś w górę, by przypomnieć sobie szczegóły. „Mówił z akcentem. Brzmiał jak jeden z tych najemników”.
links.belarusian: "О, дай падумаць... — ён закочвае вочы ўгору, прыгадваючы. — У яго быў акцэнт. Ён гучаў як адзін з тых наймітаў".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""He sounded vaguely Oranjese." He c..."
links.english: "He sounded vaguely Oranjese." He closes his eyes. "No, not vaguely, scratch that. He sounded *definitely* Oranjese."
links.polish: „Brzmiał trochę jak ktoś z Oranje” – stwierdza i zamyka oczy. „Nie, nie trochę. Brzmiał *zdecydowanie* jak ktoś z Oranje”.
links.belarusian: "Ён гучаў крыху па-араньезску, — ён заплюшчвае вочы. — Не, не крыху, выкраслі гэта. Ён гучаў *дакладна* як араньезец".

links.title: You: ""Thanks for the information.""
links.english: "Thanks for the information."
links.polish: „Dziękuję za informacje”.
links.belarusian: "Дзякуй за інфармацыю".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Sure. Anything else on your mind?"..."
links.english: "Sure. Anything else on your mind?" His lazy eyes stroll over your face.
links.polish: „Nie ma za co. Jeszcze coś?” – pyta, a jego wzrok leniwie błądzi po twojej twarzy.
links.belarusian: "Няма за што. Нешта яшчэ цябе цікавіць?" — Яго лянівы позірк блукае па тваім твары.

links.title: You: ""I need to talk with your Sunday fr..."
links.english: "I need to talk with your Sunday friend again, it's about committee business."
links.polish: „Muszę porozmawiać jeszcze raz z twoim niedzielnym przyjacielem. Chodzi o sprawy komitetu”.
links.belarusian: "Мне трэба зноў пагаварыць з тваім нядзельным сябрам, гэта наконт спраў камітэта".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, a *committee*." He smiles. "Ho..."
links.english: "Oh, a *committee*." He smiles. "How interesting..."
links.polish: „Och, *komitet*” – uśmiecha się. „Jakie to interesujące...”
links.belarusian: "О, *камітэт*, — ён усміхаецца. — Як цікава..."

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""There's only one problem: I don't..."
links.english: "There's only one problem: I don't think he wants to talk with *you*."
links.polish: „Jest tylko jeden problem: nie sądzę, aby zechciał z *tobą* porozmawiać”.
links.belarusian: "Ёсць толькі адна праблема: не думаю, што ён хоча гаварыць з *табой*".

links.title: Volition: "There's only one way through this...."
links.english: There's only one way through this. You're going to have to apologise...
links.polish: Jest tylko jedno rozwiązanie. Będziesz musiał przeprosić...
links.belarusian: Тут толькі адно выйсце. Табе давядзецца папрасіць прабачэння...

links.title: Volition: "Fortunately, saying sorry is practi..."
links.english: Fortunately, saying sorry is practically second-nature for you.
links.polish: Na szczęście przepraszanie jest dla ciebie właściwie drugą naturą.
links.belarusian: На шчасце, прасіць прабачэння для цябе амаль другая натура.

links.title: Authority: "Never. You're no sorry cop. *He* sh..."
links.english: Never. You're no sorry cop. *He* should apologise to *you*.
links.polish: Nigdy. Nie jesteś jakimś żałosnym gliną. To on powinien przeprosić ciebie.
links.belarusian: Ніколі. Ты не прабачлівы коп. *Ён* мусіць папрасіць прабачэння ў *цябе*.

links.title: You: ""Maybe you could intercede on my be..."
links.english: "Maybe you could intercede on my behalf?"
links.polish: „Może mógłbyś się za mną u niego wstawić?”
links.belarusian: "Можа, ты мог бы заступіцца за мяне?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""No." He exhales a grey trail of sm..."
links.english: "No." He exhales a grey trail of smoke. "I don't think I will. This is between the two of you, you see."
links.polish: „Nie” – odpowiada, wypuszczając z płuc szarą smugę dymu. „Raczej tego nie zrobię. To sprawa między tobą i nim”.
links.belarusian: "Не, — ён выдыхае шэрую струменьку дыму. — Не думаю. Гэта паміж вамі двума, бачыш".

links.title: You: ""Then I guess I should apologise fo..."
links.english: "Then I guess I should apologise for that little *misunderstanding* in the apartments."
links.polish: „No to chyba powinienem przeprosić za to małe *nieporozumienie* w apartamentach”.
links.belarusian: "Тады, відаць, мне варта папрасіць прабачэння за тое маленькае *непаразуменне* ў кватэрах".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Yes." He nods. "I think that would..."
links.english: "Yes." He nods. "I think that would be prudent..."
links.polish: „Tak” – kiwa głową. „Myślę, że to byłoby na miejscu...”
links.belarusian: "Так, — ён ківае. — Думаю, гэта было б разважліва..."

links.title: You: ""You can tell him I'm prepared to a..."
links.english: "You can tell him I'm prepared to accept his apology anytime."
links.polish: „Możesz mu przekazać, że jestem gotów w każdej chwili przyjąć jego przeprosiny”.
links.belarusian: "Можаш перадаць яму, што я гатовы прыняць ягоныя прабачэнні ў любы час".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: "A bemused expression. "Oh, I don't..."
links.english: A bemused expression. "Oh, I don't think *you* should be expecting an apology from *him*."
links.polish: Na jego twarzy pojawia się rozbawienie. „Och, nie sądzę, abyś to *ty* powinien oczekiwać przeprosin od *niego*”.
links.belarusian: Збянтэжаны выраз. "О, не думаю, што *табе* варта чакаць прабачэнняў ад *яго*".

links.title: Authority: "Then you have nothing more to say h..."
links.english: Then you have nothing more to say here.
links.polish: Nie masz zatem tu nic więcej do powiedzenia.
links.belarusian: Тады табе больш няма чаго тут сказаць.

links.title: Empathy: "Don't be foolish. There's greater t..."
links.english: Don't be foolish. There's greater things at stake here than your pride.
links.polish: Nie bądź głupi. Tu chodzi o rzeczy ważniejsze niż twoja duma.
links.belarusian: Не будзь дурнем. Тут на коне нешта значна большае, чым твой гонар.

links.title: You: ""Okay, fine. *I'm* the one who shou..."
links.english: "Okay, fine. *I'm* the one who should apologise."
links.polish: „Dobra, niech będzie. To *ja* powinienem przeprosić”.
links.belarusian: "Добра, хай так. Гэта *я* мушу папрасіць прабачэння".

links.title: You: ""Then he and I have nothing more to..."
links.english: "Then he and I have nothing more to discuss."
links.polish: „W takim razie nie mam z nim już o czym rozmawiać”.
links.belarusian: "Тады нам з ім больш няма чаго абмяркоўваць".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, he'll be *devastated* to hear..."
links.english: "Oh, he'll be *devastated* to hear that, I'm sure..." He smiles.
links.polish: „Och, z pewnością będzie *zdruzgotany*, gdy się o tym dowie...” – odpowiada z uśmiechem.
links.belarusian: "О, ён будзе проста *спустошаны*, калі пачуе гэта, я ўпэўнены..." — Ён усміхаецца.

links.title: Drama: "He doesn't care one way or another...."
links.english: He doesn't care one way or another. For him, it's all one entertaining chamber play.
links.polish: Jest mu wszystko jedno. Dla niego to tylko interesujący spektakl.
links.belarusian: Яму ўсё адно так ці інакш. Для яго гэта ўсяго толькі забаўны камерны спектакль.

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""What, you're going to blow a lead,..."
links.english: "What, you're going to blow a lead, just like that?" The lieutenant gives you an incredulous look.
links.polish: „Zamierzasz ot tak zrezygnować z tego tropu?” – pyta porucznik, patrząc na ciebie z niedowierzaniem.
links.belarusian: "Што, вы збіраецеся страціць зачэпку проста так?" — Лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе з недаверам.

links.title: Kim Kitsuragi: ""I'm not sure if you've noticed, bu..."
links.english: "I'm not sure if you've noticed, but Martinaise isn't exactly crawling with Coalition representatives. You're going to have to look for someone else now."
links.polish: „Nie jestem pewny, czy zauważyłeś, ale Martinaise nie roi się wcale od przedstawicieli Koalicji. Będziesz musiał poszukać teraz kogoś innego”.
links.belarusian: "Не ведаю, ці заўважылі вы, але Марцінэз не тое каб кішыць прадстаўнікамі Кааліцыі. Цяпер вам давядзецца шукаць кагосьці іншага".

links.title: Empathy: "What are you doing, Harry? You bett..."
links.english: What are you doing, Harry? You better hope there's someone else around who can help you get in touch with the Coalition...
links.polish: Co ty robisz, Harry? Lepiej miej nadzieję, że trafi się ktoś inny, kto umożliwi ci jakiś kontakt z Koalicją...
links.belarusian: Што ты робіш, Гары? Лепей спадзявайся, што паблізу ёсць нехта іншы, хто дапаможа табе звязацца з Кааліцыяй...

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""In any event, good luck with whate..."
links.english: "In any event, good luck with whatever it is you're up to."
links.polish: „W każdym razie, życzę powodzenia”.
links.belarusian: "У любым разе, поспехаў з усім, што ты там задумаў".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""And if I may ask, gendarme, what i..."
links.english: "And if I may ask, gendarme, what is this *committee* about?" He takes a measured drag of his cigarette.
links.polish: „Czy mogę zapytać, żandarmie, o jaki *komitet* chodzi?” – pyta, zaciągając się z rozmysłem dymem ze swojego papierosa.
links.belarusian: "І калі дазволіш запытацца, жандарме, пра што гэты *камітэт*?" — Ён размерана зацягваецца цыгарэтай.

links.title: Rhetoric: "He's all bemused skepticism. He doe..."
links.english: He's all bemused skepticism. He doesn't *actually* care what you want with his friend.
links.polish: Jest zdziwiony, ale i sceptyczny. Tak *naprawdę* nie obchodzi go, czego chcesz od jego znajomego.
links.belarusian: Ён увесь — збянтэжаны скепсіс. Яму *насамрэч* усё адно, што табе трэба ад ягонага сябра.

links.title: You: ""I'm not really sure, I'm just tryi..."
links.english: "I'm not really sure, I'm just trying to reach a higher authority."
links.polish: „Nie jestem pewien. Chcę po prostu skontaktować się z kimś bliższym władzy”.
links.belarusian: "Я сам не надта ўпэўнены, проста спрабую выйсці на вышэйшае начальства".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Sounds like a bore, frankly." He t..."
links.english: "Sounds like a bore, frankly." He takes a drag of his cigarette. "All the fun stuff's down here..."
links.polish: „To brzmi okropnie nudno, szczerze mówiąc” – odpowiada i zaciąga się dymem z papierosa. „Tutaj dzieją się najciekawsze rzeczy...”
links.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, гучыць нудна, — ён зацягваецца цыгарэтай. — Усё самае цікавае тут, унізе...".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""In any case, I would *love* to hel..."
links.english: "In any case, I would *love* to help, but the thing is, I don't know *where* he is. We don't talk about everything, you see..." He gently taps the end of his cigarette with his forefinger.
links.polish: „W każdym razie, *chciałbym* pomóc, ale problem w tym, że nie wiem, *gdzie* on jest. Właściwie mało ze sobą rozmawiamy...” – wyjaśnia, delikatnie strzepując palcem wskazującym popiół z papierosa.
links.belarusian: "У любым разе, я б з *радасцю* дапамог, але рэч у тым, што я не ведаю, *дзе* ён. Мы не гаворым пра ўсё на свеце, разумееш... — ён пяшчотна стукае ўказальным пальцам па кончыку цыгарэты".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""He might have mentioned something..."
links.english: "He might have mentioned something about making a tour of some historical sites up the coast... in an unofficial capacity, of course."
links.polish: „Być może wspominał coś o zwiedzaniu jakichś historycznych miejsc na wybrzeżu... Oczywiście nieoficjalnie”.
links.belarusian: "Ён мог узгадваць нешта пра экскурсію па нейкіх гістарычных мясцінах уздоўж узбярэжжа... неафіцыйна, вядома ж".

links.title: You: ""Do you know when he'll be back?""
links.english: "Do you know when he'll be back?"
links.polish: „Wiesz, kiedy wróci?”
links.belarusian: "Ведаеш, калі ён вернецца?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Not a clue. I'm not his agenda kee..."
links.english: "Not a clue. I'm not his agenda keeper, you see."
links.polish: „Nie mam pojęcia. Nie jestem jego sekretarzem”.
links.belarusian: "Ніякага паняцця. Я ж не вяду ягоны расклад, сам разумееш".

links.title: You: ""I guess I'll have to look for him..."
links.english: "I guess I'll have to look for him along the coast."
links.polish: „No to będę musiał poszukać go gdzieś na wybrzeżu”.
links.belarusian: "Відаць, давядзецца пашукаць яго на ўзбярэжжы".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""I guess you will." He tips his hea..."
links.english: "I guess you will." He tips his head ever so slightly toward you.
links.polish: „Najwyraźniej” – odpowiada, kłaniając ci się lekko.
links.belarusian: "Відаць, так, — ён ледзь-ледзь хіліць галаву ў твой бок".

links.title: You: ""How did he get over the water lock..."
links.english: "How did he get over the water lock? I thought it was impassable?"
links.polish: „Jak przedostał się przez śluzę? Myślałem, że jest nie do przebycia?”
links.belarusian: "Як ён перабраўся праз шлюз? Я думаў, ён непраходны?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: "He shrugs. "He has his ways. I don'..."
links.english: He shrugs. "He has his ways. I don't need to know every detail of his life."
links.polish: Wzrusza ramionami. „Ma swoje sposoby. Nie interesują mnie szczegóły jego życia”.
links.belarusian: Ён паціскае плячыма: "У яго свае спосабы. Мне не трэба ведаць кожную дробязь пра ягонае жыццё".

links.title: You: ""It's about assigning la responsabi..."
links.english: "It's about assigning la responsabilité."
links.polish: „Chodzi o przydzielanie la responsabilité”.
links.belarusian: "Гаворка пра прызначэнне la responsabilité".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""God, of *course* it is. My friend..."
links.english: "God, of *course* it is. My friend is always trying to convince me I need a little more responsibility..."
links.polish: „Boże, *oczywiście*, że tak. Mój przyjaciel zawsze próbuje przekonać mnie, że muszę być odrobinę bardziej odpowiedzialny...”
links.belarusian: "Божа, ну *вядома* ж. Мой сябар заўсёды спрабуе пераканаць мяне, што мне трэба крыху больш адказнасці...".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""As though I don't have enough goin..."
links.english: "As though I don't have enough going on already."
links.polish: „Jakbym i bez tego nie miał dość na głowie”.
links.belarusian: "Быццам у мяне і без таго мала ўсяго адбываецца".

links.title: You: ""I'm really not at liberty to say.""
links.english: "I'm really not at liberty to say."
links.polish: „Naprawdę nie wolno mi tego zdradzić”.
links.belarusian: "Я сапраўды не маю права казаць".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, a big *secret* committee. I un..."
links.english: "Oh, a big *secret* committee. I understand perfectly..." His mouth forms a half smile.
links.polish: „Och, wielki *sekretny* komitet. Rozumiem doskonale...” – zapewnia, a na jego ustach pojawia się delikatny uśmieszek.
links.belarusian: "О, вялікі *сакрэтны* камітэт. Выдатна разумею..." — Яго вусны расплываюцца ў паўусмешцы.

links.title: You: ""I met your Sunday friend.""
links.english: "I met your Sunday friend."
links.polish: „Spotkałem twojego niedzielnego przyjaciela”.
links.belarusian: "Я сустрэў твайго нядзельнага сябра".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""You did?" A small smile adorns his..."
links.english: "You did?" A small smile adorns his face. "And how did you like him?"
links.polish: „Tak?” – jego twarz zdobi niewielki uśmiech. „Jak ci się spodobał?”
links.belarusian: "Сустрэў? — на ягоным твары з'яўляецца лёгкая ўсмешка. — І як ён табе?"

links.title: You: ""You were right, he was magical. Ma..."
links.english: "You were right, he was magical. Magically bureaucratic."
links.polish: „Miałeś rację, był magiczny. Magicznie biurokratyczny”.
links.belarusian: "Ты меў рацыю, ён быў магічным. Магічна бюракратычным".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""I told you, he can be very useful...."
links.english: "I told you, he can be very useful. I guess that's the charm of powerful people."
links.polish: „Mówiłem, że może być bardzo użyteczny. To jest chyba czar potężnych ludzi”.
links.belarusian: "Я ж казаў, ён можа быць вельмі карысным. Пэўна, у гэтым і ёсць шарм уплывовых людзей".

links.title: You: ""Who is he?""
links.english: "Who is he?"
links.polish: „Kim on jest?”
links.belarusian: "Хто ён такі?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""A visitor from the first world. He..."
links.english: "A visitor from the first world. He's not like you and me, gendarme." He smiles and his smile seems melancholic. "He can always return."
links.polish: „To gość z pierwszego świata. Nie jest taki jak ty czy ja, żandarmie” – uśmiecha się melancholijnie. „Może zawsze wrócić”.
links.belarusian: "Госць з першага свету. Ён не такі, як мы з табой, жандарме, — ён усміхаецца, і ягоная ўсмешка выглядае меланхалічнай. — Ён заўсёды можа вярнуцца".

links.title: You: ""Return where?""
links.english: "Return where?"
links.polish: „Gdzie wrócić?”
links.belarusian: "Вярнуцца куды?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""To his opportunities in Occident,..."
links.english: "To his opportunities in Occident, Sur-la-Clef. Still..." He breathes in and keeps his lungs filled for a moment, before letting it out. "His coming and going brings some life to the village."
links.polish: „Do możliwości, jakie ma w Okcydencie, Sur-la-Clef. Mimo to...” – zaciąga się dymem i zatrzymuje go na chwilę w płucach. „Jego wizyty ożywiają trochę tę wioskę”.
links.belarusian: "Да сваіх магчымасцей у Акцыдэнце, Сюр-ля-Кле. І ўсё ж... — ён удыхае і затрымлівае паветра ў лёгкіх, перш чым выдыхнуць. — Яго прыходы і адыходы прыўносяць трохі жыцця ў гэтую вёску".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Or is it just money, I don't know...."
links.english: "Or is it just money, I don't know..." He stares at the bar.
links.polish: „A może chodzi tylko o pieniądze, sam nie wiem...” – stwierdza, wpatrując się w bar.
links.belarusian: "Ці гэта проста грошы, не ведаю..." — Ён глядзіць на барную стойку.

links.title: You: ""What are you, you two?""
links.english: "What are you, you two?"
links.polish: „Co was właściwie łączy?”
links.belarusian: "Хто вы наогул адзін аднаму?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Friends, I told you. Sunday friend..."
links.english: "Friends, I told you. Sunday friends. Friends who like to get together from time to time."
links.polish: „Jesteśmy przyjaciółmi – już mówiłem. Niedzielnymi przyjaciółmi. Przyjaciółmi, którzy od czasu do czasu lubią się ze sobą spotykać”.
links.belarusian: "Сябры, я ж казаў. Нядзельныя сябры. Сябры, якія любяць збірацца час ад часу".

links.title: You: ""What does it mean -- a Sunday frie..."
links.english: "What does it mean -- a Sunday friend?"
links.polish: „Niedzielny przyjaciel. Co to znaczy?”
links.belarusian: "Што гэта значыць — нядзельны сябра?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: "He sighs: "That he won't be there w..."
links.english: He sighs: "That he won't be there when times get tough, I guess."
links.polish: Wzdycha. „Że nie będzie go tutaj, gdy nadejdą trudne czasy”.
links.belarusian: Ён уздыхае: "Што яго не будзе побач, калі прыйдуць цяжкія часы, пэўна".

links.title: You: ""Is that even a friend?""
links.english: "Is that even a friend?"
links.polish: „To to w ogóle jest przyjaciel?”
links.belarusian: "І гэта наогул сябар?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""It is -- on Sundays." He smiles."
links.english: "It is -- on Sundays." He smiles.
links.polish: „Tak – w niedziele” – uśmiecha się.
links.belarusian: "Так — па нядзелях, — ён усміхаецца".

links.title: You: ""Why was he staying at your place i..."
links.english: "Why was he staying at your place in the middle of night?"
links.polish: „Czemu był u ciebie w środku nocy?”
links.belarusian: "Чаму ён начаваў у цябе сярод ночы?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""He has keys. And he likes the view..."
links.english: "He has keys. And he likes the view..." He waves gently with his cigarette-holding hand. "To the sea, I mean."
links.polish: „Ma klucze. I lubi ten widok...” – odpowiada, wykonując gest dłonią z papierosem. „Na morze, oczywiście”.
links.belarusian: "У яго ёсць ключы. І яму падабаецца від... — ён мякка жэстыкулюе рукой з цыгарэтай. — На мора, я маю на ўвазе".

links.title: You: ""I don't want to talk about other p..."
links.english: "I don't want to talk about other people, I want to talk about you."
links.polish: „Nie chcę rozmawiać o innych ludziach. Chcę porozmawiać o tobie”.
links.belarusian: "Я не хачу гаварыць пра іншых людзей, я хачу гаварыць пра цябе".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Hmm?" He hums. "What about me, gen..."
links.english: "Hmm?" He hums. "What about me, gendarme?"
links.polish: „Hmm?” – mruczy. „Czyli o czym, żandarmie?”
links.belarusian: "Хм? — мурлыкае ён. — А што пра мяне, жандарме?"

links.title: You: ""I didn't like him as much as I lik..."
links.english: "I didn't like him as much as I like you."
links.polish: „Nie spodobał mi się tak bardzo jak ty”.
links.belarusian: "Ён мне спадабаўся не так моцна, як ты".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Aw, shoot." He bursts out laughing..."
links.english: "Aw, shoot." He bursts out laughing. "Why not?"
links.polish: „A niech mnie!” – wybucha śmiechem. „Czemu nie?”
links.belarusian: "Ой, ды ладна, — ён заходзіцца смехам. — Чаму не?"

links.title: You: ""I didn't. He's a government offici..."
links.english: "I didn't. He's a government official. I don't trust governments."
links.polish: „Nie spodobał. To urzędnik rządowy. Nie ufam rządom”.
links.belarusian: "Не спадабаўся. Ён урадавы чыноўнік. Я не давяраю ўрадам".

links.title: You: "What is it about the way he carries..."
links.english: What is it about the way he carries himself?
links.polish: Nosi się w jakiś niezwykły sposób. O co tu chodzi?
links.belarusian: Што такога ў тым, як ён сябе трымае?

links.title: Composure: "Could he be... a member of the *hom..."
links.english: Could he be... a member of the *homo-sexual underground*?
links.polish: Czy on może być... członkiem *homoseksualnego podziemia*?
links.belarusian: Ці можа ён быць... сябрам *гомасексуальнага падполля*?

links.title: Physical Instrument: "Yes, this man is definitely one of..."
links.english: Yes, this man is definitely one of the homos, I've seen them homos with my own eyes.
links.polish: Tak, ten gość jest zdecydowanie homo. Doskonale wiem, jak oni wyglądają.
links.belarusian: Так, гэты мужык дакладна з гэтых гома, я бачыў гэтых гома на ўласныя вочы.

links.title: Electrochemistry: "This *sexual* thing seems interesti..."
links.english: This *sexual* thing seems interesting... Ask around, become involved.
links.polish: Ciekawa ta *seksualna* sprawa... Popytaj ludzi, zaangażuj się w to.
links.belarusian: Гэтая *сексуальная* тэма выглядае цікава... Параспытвай, далучыся.

links.title: Encyclopedia: "Just pointing it out, we're not tal..."
links.english: Just pointing it out, we're not talking about some kind of a cult with *members* here, you made it up.
links.polish: Przypomnę tylko, że nie rozmawiamy tu o żadnym kulcie mającym *członków*. Wymyśliłeś to.
links.belarusian: Проста заўважу: мы тут гаворым не пра нейкі культ з *членамі*, ты сам гэта выдумаў.

links.title: You: ""Are you... are you part of the *ho..."
links.english: "Are you... are you part of the *homo-sexual underground*?"
links.polish: „Czy ty... jesteś częścią *homoseksualnego podziemia*?”
links.belarusian: "Ці ты... ці ты частка *гомасексуальнага падполля*?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""The *homo-sexual underground*?" Th..."
links.english: "The *homo-sexual underground*?" The smoker sits up immediately, his eyes wide with amused surprise; a honeyed smile lingers on his lips.
links.polish: „*Homoseksualnego podziemia*?” – palacz prostuje się, w jego oczach widać rozbawienie, a na ustach pojawia się słodki uśmiech.
links.belarusian: "*Гомасексуальнага падполля*?" — Курэц імгненна выпрамляецца, ягоныя вочы расшыраюцца ад забаўленага здзіўлення; мядовая ўсмешка застывае на ягоных вуснах.

links.title: Drama: "He's assuming a role to mock you --..."
links.english: He's assuming a role to mock you -- or to entertain himself with your ignorance. Don't fall for it!
links.polish: Przyjmuje pozę, żeby cię wykpić albo żeby wyśmiać twoją ignorancję. Nie wolno na to pozwolić!
links.belarusian: Ён уваходзіць у ролю, каб паздзекавацца з цябе — ці пацешыцца тваім невуцтвам. Не паддавайся!

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Why yes I am, officer. Why, do you..."
links.english: "Why yes I am, officer. Why, do you want to *investigate*?"
links.polish: „Ależ oczywiście, funkcjonariuszu. Chcesz przeprowadzić *dochodzenie*?”
links.belarusian: "Ну вядома ж, афіцэру. А што, хочаш правесці *расследаванне*?"

links.title: You: ""Yes, I want to hear more about thi..."
links.english: "Yes, I want to hear more about this *homo-sexual underground* you're part of."
links.polish: „Tak, chcę dowiedzieć się więcej o tym *homoseksualnym podziemiu*, do którego należysz”.
links.belarusian: "Так, я хачу пачуць больш пра гэтае *гомасексуальнае падполле*, часткай якога ты з'яўляешся".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh, it's a *pleasure* group... a s..."
links.english: "Oh, it's a *pleasure* group... a sub-rosa pleasure group congregating in cellars under the cover of night... Saturday night, sometimes even *Friday* night!"
links.polish: „Och, to grupa *uciech*... Potajemna grupa skupiająca się na przyjemności spotykająca się w piwnicach pod osłoną nocy – sobotniej nocy, a czasem nawet *piątkowej* nocy!”
links.belarusian: "О, гэта суполка *асалоды*... таемная суполка асалоды, што збіраецца ў сутарэннях пад покрывам ночы... суботняй ночы, часам нават *пятнічнай*!"

links.title: You: ""What about Thursday night?""
links.english: "What about Thursday night?"
links.polish: „A co z czwartkową nocą?”
links.belarusian: "А як наконт чацвярговай ночы?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Or Thursday night! Sometimes the c..."
links.english: "Or Thursday night! Sometimes the congregating doesn't even end, it carries on into our daily life..." He lowers his voice conspiratorially and looks around.
links.polish: „Albo czwartkowej nocy! Czasem nawet zgromadzenie się nie kończy, lecz trwa i towarzyszy nam w naszym codziennym życiu...” – wyjaśnia konspiracyjnym szeptem, rozglądając się wokoło.
links.belarusian: "Або чацвярговай ночы! Часам зборышчы нават не спыняюцца і перацякаюць у нашае паўсядзённае жыццё..." — Ён змоўніцкі сцішвае голас і азіраецца.

links.title: You: ""But why do you convene, what do yo..."
links.english: "But why do you convene, what do you *do*?"
links.polish: „Ale czemu się spotykacie? Co *robicie*?”
links.belarusian: "Але чаму вы збіраецеся, што вы *робіце*?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Oh we're ambitious, we want to des..."
links.english: "Oh we're ambitious, we want to destroy the last vestiges of meaning, the last things people in Revachol have to hold on to, the true symbols of security -- the meaning of man and woman, mother and father, their marriage."
links.polish: „Och, jesteśmy ambitni – chcemy zniszczyć ostatnie ostoje znaczenia, ostatnie reduty, na których chronią się mieszkańcy Revacholu, prawdziwe symbole bezpieczeństwa: tego, czym jest bycie mężczyzną i kobietą, matką i ojcem oraz czym jest ich małżeństwo”.
links.belarusian: "О, мы амбіцыйныя: мы хочам знішчыць апошнія рэшткі сэнсу, апошняе, за што людзі ў Рэвашолі яшчэ могуць трымацца, сапраўдныя сімвалы бяспекі — сэнс мужчыны і жанчыны, маці і бацькі, іхняга шлюбу".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""*Everything* will be constantly sh..."
links.english: "*Everything* will be constantly shifting and moving under our rule, the future will belong to a circus of identities, just spinning around, surreal and unreal... You won't even know who you are anymore."
links.polish: „Pod naszymi rządami *wszystko* będzie się nieustannie zmieniać i przemieszczać, przyszłość będzie należała do cyrku tożsamości – wirującego, surrealistycznego i nierealnego… Nie będziesz nawet wiedział, kim jesteś”.
links.belarusian: "Пад нашай уладай *усё* будзе пастаянна змяняцца і рухацца, будучыня будзе належаць цырку ідэнтычнасцей, што проста кружыцца ў віры, сюррэалістычным і нерэальным... Ты нават больш не будзеш ведаць, хто ты такі".

links.title: You: ""But I like knowing who I am.""
links.english: "But I like knowing who I am."
links.polish: „Ale ja lubię wiedzieć, kim jestem”.
links.belarusian: "Але мне падабаецца ведаць, хто я".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""But do you also like the *razzle-d..."
links.english: "But do you also like the *razzle-dazzle* of gold? Do you like parties and discos and having fun under the vibrant lights of Saturday night?"
links.polish: „Ale czy lubisz też *blichtr* złota? Czy lubisz imprezy i dyskoteki, i zabawę w tętniących światłach sobotniej nocy?”
links.belarusian: "Але ці падабаецца табе таксама *бліскавічны шык* золата? Ці падабаюцца табе вечарыны, дыскатэкі і забавы пад пульсуючым святлом суботняга вечара?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Because instead of the traditional..."
links.english: "Because instead of the traditional family unit we're going to have all this *razzamatazz*," he wiggles his hands, "and mysteries, of course, too -- mysteries of *sexual* nature, very esoteric. And disco music and drugs."
links.polish: „Bo zamiast tradycyjnej rodziny będziemy mieli cały ten *mętlik*” – wyjaśnia, przebierając palcami. „I tajemnice, oczywiście – tajemnice o *seksualnej* naturze, bardzo ezoteryczne. I muzykę disco, i narkotyki”.
links.belarusian: "Бо замест традыцыйнай сям'і ў нас будзе ўвесь гэты *вір-гармідар*, — ён варушыць пальцамі, — і таямніцы, вядома ж, таксама — таямніцы *сексуальнага* характару, вельмі эзатэрычныя. І дыска-музыка, і наркотыкі".

links.title: You: ""I do like disco, maybe I should ge..."
links.english: "I do like disco, maybe I should get into it?"
links.polish: „Lubię disco. Może powinienem się w to wkręcić?”
links.belarusian: "Я сапраўды люблю дыска, можа, мне варта гэтым заняцца?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""You can't just get into it, you ha..."
links.english: "You can't just get into it, you have to be born into it -- one is either already *in* the homo-sexual movement or forever excluded from it."
links.polish: „Nie da się w to tak po prostu wkręcić – z tym trzeba się urodzić. Albo się do homoseksualnego ruchu *należy*, albo jest się z niego na zawsze wykluczonym”.
links.belarusian: "Ты не можаш проста так у гэта ўвайсці, з гэтым трэба нарадзіцца — ты альбо ўжо *ў* гомасексуальным руху, альбо назаўсёды выключаны з яго".

links.title: You: ""What if I can't remember whether I..."
links.english: "What if I can't remember whether I'm in or not? What if I can't remember anything about my life -- aside from the fact that I like disco?"
links.polish: „A jeśli nie pamiętam, czy do niego należę, czy nie? Co jeśli nie pamiętam ze swojego życia nic poza tym, że lubię disco?”
links.belarusian: "А што, калі я не памятаю, у ім я ці не? Што, калі я нічога пра сваё жыццё не памятаю — акрамя таго, што люблю дыска?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Beautiful!" The smoker crawls up t..."
links.english: "Beautiful!" The smoker crawls up to you like an animal preparing to jump. "Beautiful, that's exactly what we're looking for! Who knows, maybe you *were* homo-sexual in the past, maybe all of that has been *repressed*..." He circles his hands around you.
links.polish: „Pięknie!” – palacz podchodzi do ciebie jak zwierzę przygotowujące się do skoku. „Pięknie, właśnie do tego dążymy! Kto wie, może w przeszłości *byłeś* homoseksualistą – może to wszystko było *tłumione*...” – zatacza swoimi rękami wokół ciebie koła.
links.belarusian: "Цудоўна! — курэц падкрадаецца да цябе, нібы звер перад скачком. — Цудоўна, гэта акурат тое, што мы шукаем! Хто ведае, можа, ты *быў* гомасексуалам у мінулым, можа, усё гэта было *задушана*... — ён робіць рукамі кругі вакол цябе".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""I have to say that you do look lik..."
links.english: "I have to say that you do look like someone who might be part of *the underground*. You have that very distinctive 'I-can't-understand-what's-going-on-here' look."
links.polish: „Muszę powiedzieć, że wyglądasz jak ktoś, kto mógłby należeć do *podziemia*. Masz to bardzo charakterystyczne spojrzenie, jakbyś nie miał pojęcia, co się wokół ciebie dzieje”.
links.belarusian: "Мушу прызнаць, ты сапраўды выглядаеш як нехта, хто мог бы быць часткай *падполля*. У цябе гэты вельмі характэрны позірк накшталт 'я-не-магу-зразумець-што-тут-адбываецца'".

links.title: You: ""Okay..." (Blink.) "Okay, I have to..."
links.english: "Okay..." (Blink.) "Okay, I have to think about it."
links.polish: „No dobrze”. (Mrugnij). „Dobrze. Muszę to przemyśleć”.
links.belarusian: "Добра..." (Мільгануць вачыма.) "Добра, мне трэба падумаць пра гэта".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Do think about it, officer." He st..."
links.english: "Do think about it, officer." He starts laughing and leans back against the counter.
links.polish: „Pomyśl o tym, funkcjonariuszu” – odpowiada i zaczyna się śmiać, opierając się o ladę.
links.belarusian: "Падумай пра гэта, афіцэру, — ён пачынае смяяцца і адкідваецца на стойку".

links.title: You: ""This is gonna be, like, a twenty h..."
links.english: "This is gonna be, like, a twenty hour mind-project for me. Twenty hours at least."
links.polish: „To będzie dla mnie dwudziestoczterogodzinny projekt umysłowy. No, przynajmniej dwudziesto”.
links.belarusian: "Гэта будзе, тыпу, дваццацігадзінны разумовы праект для мяне. Мінімум дваццаць гадзін".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Absolutely *wonderful*.""
links.english: "Absolutely *wonderful*."
links.polish: „Absolutnie *cudownie*”.
links.belarusian: "Абсалютна *цудоўна*".

links.title: Conceptualization: "A man like you can figure out his s..."
links.english: A man like you can figure out his sexuality in a working day. It won't be twenty hours unless you want to enter the heightened realms of the *fantasme érotique* afterwards. Then it may be twenty hours *or more*! But that would be on your own time.
links.polish: Mężczyzna taki jak ty może pojąć swoją seksualność w jeden dzień roboczy. Nie zajmie to dwudziestu godzin, o ile nie zechcesz później wkroczyć we wspaniałe krainy *fantasme érotique*. Wtedy może to zająć dwadzieścia albo i więcej! Ale to już będzie twoja własna praca.
links.belarusian: Такі мужчына, як ты, можа разабрацца са сваёй сексуальнасцю за працоўны дзень. Гэта не зойме дваццаць гадзін, калі толькі ты не захочаш потым увайсці ў узнёслыя сферы *fantasme érotique*. Тады гэта можа заняць дваццаць гадзін *ці больш*! Але гэта ўжо ў твой асабісты час.

links.title: You: ""Okay, then I'm definitely not in.""
links.english: "Okay, then I'm definitely not in."
links.polish: „Dobra, to na pewno się nie wkręcę”.
links.belarusian: "Добра, тады я дакладна не ў ім".

links.title: You: ""No, this is not me.""
links.english: "No, this is not me."
links.polish: „Nie, to nie dla mnie”.
links.belarusian: "Не, гэта не маё".

links.title: You: ""That much fun should be illegal.""
links.english: "That much fun should be illegal."
links.polish: „Tak dobra zabawa powinna być zabroniona”.
links.belarusian: "Столькі весялосці мусіць быць незаконным".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Ah... But for the better part of h..."
links.english: "Ah... But for the better part of history it *has been* illegal."
links.polish: „Cóż... Przez większą część historii *była* zabroniona”.
links.belarusian: "А... але ж большую частку гісторыі яна і *была* незаконнай".

links.title: You: ""But it isn't anymore?""
links.english: "But it isn't anymore?"
links.polish: „Ale już nie jest?”
links.belarusian: "Але цяпер ужо не?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""No." He studies you from across th..."
links.english: "No." He studies you from across the table.
links.polish: „Nie” – odpowiada i przygląda ci się uważnie.
links.belarusian: "Не, — ён вывучае цябе праз стол".

links.title: You: ""Does it have anything to do with d..."
links.english: "Does it have anything to do with disco?"
links.polish: „Czy to ma coś wspólnego z disco?”
links.belarusian: "Ці мае гэта хоць якое дачыненне да дыска?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Yes, we listen to a lot of disco...."
links.english: "Yes, we listen to a lot of disco. Some say we *engineered* disco to spread our vision of a vertiginous, ever-changing society, where all there is a razzle-dazzle of gold!"
links.polish: „Tak, często słuchamy disco. Niektórzy twierdzą nawet, że *stworzyliśmy* disco, aby szerzyć naszą wizję przyprawiającego o zawrót głowy, nieustannie zmieniającego się społeczeństwa, w którym wszystko lśni złotym blichtrem!”
links.belarusian: "Так, мы слухаем шмат дыска. Некаторыя кажуць, што мы *сканструявалі* дыска, каб пашыраць наша бачанне галавакружнага грамадства, якое вечна змяняецца, дзе ёсць толькі бліскавічны шык золата!"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""We are going to *change* the famil..."
links.english: "We are going to *change* the family unit with all this razzamatazz and finger-dancing," he wiggles his hands, "and with mysteries, of course, the mysteries are also of sexual nature, very esoteric."
links.polish: „Zamierzamy *zmienić* całym tym mętlikiem i tańcem palców podstawową jednostkę społeczną, rodzinę” – wyjaśnia, przebierając palcami. „I tajemnicami, oczywiście – tajemnice mają też seksualną naturę, bardzo ezoteryczną”.
links.belarusian: "Мы збіраемся *змяніць* інстытут сям'і ўсім гэтым вірам-гармідарам і танцам пальцаў, — ён варушыць рукамі, — і таямніцамі, вядома ж: таямніцы таксама сексуальнага характару, вельмі эзатэрычныя".

links.title: You: ""Other questions, I had other quest..."
links.english: "Other questions, I had other questions, really!" (Try to back off.)
links.polish: „Dobrze, mam inne pytania. Mam je, naprawdę!” (Spróbuj się z tego wycofać).
links.belarusian: "Іншыя пытанні, у мяне былі іншыя пытанні, праўда!" (Паспрабаваць адступіць.)

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: "The smoker starts laughing and lean..."
links.english: The smoker starts laughing and leans back against the counter: "Sure thing, officer, what do you want to know next?"
links.polish: Palacz zaczyna się śmiać i opiera się plecami o ladę. „Oczywiście, funkcjonariuszu. Co chcesz jeszcze wiedzieć?”
links.belarusian: Курэц пачынае смяяцца і адкідваецца на стойку: "Вядома ж, афіцэру, пра што ты хочаш даведацца далей?"

links.title: You: ""No, I just wanted to know whether..."
links.english: "No, I just wanted to know whether you were one of them."
links.polish: „Nie, chciałem tylko wiedzieć, czy do niego należysz”.
links.belarusian: "Не, я проста хацеў даведацца, ці ты адзін з іх".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Well, I *am* one of them, one of t..."
links.english: "Well, I *am* one of them, one of this *sub-rosa pleasure group* congregating in cellars under the cover of night... Saturday night, sometimes even *Friday* night!"
links.polish: „No cóż, *jestem* jednym z nich – należę do jednej z tych *potajemnych grup rozkoszy* gromadzących się w piwnicach pod osłoną nocy... sobotniej nocy, a czasem nawet *piątkowej* nocy!”
links.belarusian: "Ну, я *сапраўды* адзін з іх, з гэтай *таемнай суполкі асалоды*, што збіраецца ў сутарэннях пад покрывам ночы... суботняй ночы, часам нават *пятнічнай*!"

links.title: You: ""Let's just not talk about this any..."
links.english: "Let's just not talk about this anymore."
links.polish: „Dajmy już spokój z tym tematem”.
links.belarusian: "Давай проста больш не гаварыць пра гэта".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Why not? Don't you want to hear ab..."
links.english: "Why not? Don't you want to hear about how we want to destroy the last vestiges of meaning, the last things people in Revachol have to hold on to, the meaning of man and woman?"
links.polish: „Dlaczego? Nie chcesz usłyszeć o tym, jak chcemy zniszczyć ostatnie ostoje znaczenia, ostatnie reduty, na których chronią się mieszkańcy Revacholu, tego, czym jest bycie mężczyzną i kobietą?”
links.belarusian: "Чаму б не? Хіба ты не хочаш пачуць пра тое, як мы хочам знішчыць апошнія рэшткі сэнсу, апошняе, за што людзі ў Рэвашолі яшчэ могуць трымацца, — сэнс мужчыны і жанчыны?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Or the true symbols of security, m..."
links.english: "Or the true symbols of security, mother and father and their everlasting marriage... *Everything* will be constantly shifting and moving under our rule, the future will belong to a *circus* of identities, just spinning around, surreal and unreal..."
links.polish: „Albo prawdziwych symboli bezpieczeństwa: matki i ojca oraz ich nierozerwalnego małżeństwa... Pod naszymi rządami *wszystko* będzie się nieustannie zmieniać i przemieszczać, przyszłość będzie należała do *cyrku* tożsamości – wirującego, surrealistycznego i nierealnego…”
links.belarusian: "Ці сапраўдныя сімвалы бяспекі, маці і бацьку і іх вечны шлюб... Пад нашай уладай *усё* будзе пастаянна змяняцца і рухацца, будучыня будзе належаць *цырку* ідэнтычнасцей, што проста кружыцца ў віры, сюррэалістычным і нерэальным..."

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""You won't even know who you are an..."
links.english: "You won't even know who you are anymore."
links.polish: „Nie będziesz nawet wiedział, kim jesteś”.
links.belarusian: "Ты нават больш не будзеш ведаць, хто ты такі".

links.title: You: "I'm not bringing it up -- let it go..."
links.english: I'm not bringing it up -- let it go.
links.polish: Nie będę o tym wspominał. Odpuść.
links.belarusian: Я не буду гэта ўздымаць — адпусціць.

links.english: "About this hat I'm wearing..."

links.belarusian: "Наконт гэтага капелюша на мне..."

links.english: "You can keep it, I don't mind. I can appreciate beauty when I see it."
links.polish: „Możesz to zatrzymać, nie mam nic przeciwko. Potrafię docenić piękno, gdy je ujrzę”.
links.belarusian: "Можаш пакінуць сабе, я не супраць. Я ўмею цаніць прыгажосць, калі бачу яе".

links.title: You: ""I wasn't really planning on giving..."
links.english: "I wasn't really planning on giving it back anyway."
links.polish: „I tak nie zamierzałem raczej ci tego oddawać”.
links.belarusian: "Я і так не надта планаваў вяртаць яго".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""How cunning." He raises his brows..."
links.english: "How cunning." He raises his brows and you're not sure whether he's mocking you or not. "I like men who take what they want."
links.polish: „Ależ tyś podstępny” – unosi brew i nie jesteś pewny, czy mówi poważnie, czy tylko się z tobą droczy. „Lubię mężczyzn, którzy biorą, co chcą”.
links.belarusian: "Як хітра, — ён ускідвае бровы, і ты не ўпэўнены, ці ён здзекуецца з цябе, ці не. — Мне падабаюцца мужчыны, якія бяруць тое, што хочуць".

links.title: You: ""Thanks. It's like carrying a piece..."
links.english: "Thanks. It's like carrying a piece of you with me at all times."
links.polish: „Dzięki. To jak noszenie zawsze przy sobie części ciebie”.
links.belarusian: "Дзякуй. Гэта нібыта заўсёды насіць часцінку цябе з сабой".

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Is it now?" He starts laughing. "W..."
links.english: "Is it now?" He starts laughing. "Well, enjoy it."
links.polish: „Doprawdy?” – pyta, śmiejąc się. „W takim razie korzystaj”.
links.belarusian: "Вось як? — ён пачынае смяяцца. — Ну што ж, на здароўе".

links.title: You: ""I took it to blend in. I'm underco..."

links.belarusian: "Я ўзяў яго, каб зліцца з натоўпам. Я працую пад прыкрыццём, разумееш?"

links.title: Smoker on the Balcony: ""Blend in where?" He raises his bro..."

links.belarusian: "Зліцца з натоўпам дзе? — ён ускідвае бровы. — На карнавале?"

links.english: "About this robe I'm wearing..."

links.belarusian: "Наконт капелюша і халата на мне..."

links.belarusian: [Сысці.]

dialogueTree.english: "Hi, gendarme. Another rendezvous." There he is again -- the smoker on the balcony! Right here in the Whirling-in-Rags.
dialogueTree.polish: „Witam, żandarmie. Kolejne rendezvous”. To znowu on – palacz z balkonu! I to tutaj, w Whirling-in-Rags.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Прывітанне, жандарме. Чарговае рандэву". Вось ён зноў — курэц на гаўбцы! Проста тут, у Whirling-in-Rags.
